briefdescription.para: Returns the complete text of a glyph sheet, reconciled against a manifest's glyphs table.

detaileddescription.para: sheetText is the existing sheet's text, or empty when no sheet exists yet. The manifest's ## glyphs table decides which cells exist in the returned sheet: a cell present in both the table and the existing sheet keeps its own width and its artwork; a cell absent from the table is not emitted. The cells repack in table order and the canvas resizes to fit them. The parsed existing sheet is read and never modified.

parameterdescription.para: The font family manifest, read for its glyphs and guides tables.
The existing sheet's text, or empty when none exists.

simplesect.para: The complete text of the reconciled glyph sheet.
